j4q.models

Class GameObject

  • java.lang.Object
    • j4q.models.GameObject
  • Direct Known Subclasses:
    Background360, Spaceship

    public class GameObject
extends java.lang.Object
    Represents an object in the scene graph, supporting components, hierarchy, and rendering.

    The GameObject class manages child objects, components, transforms, and drawing logic.
